short_blurb: Remodels, additions & ADUs — licensed general contractor in Encino.
local_note: Whether you're modernizing a kitchen, adding a primary suite, converting a garage, or building an ADU, Palm Crest Builders brings licensed, code-compliant construction to Encino. As a Class B general building contractor we coordinate every trade under one contract and keep your project on schedule and on budget. We build throughout Encino, including Royal Oaks, Encino Hills, Balboa Highlands, and nearby neighborhoods.

faqs.q: Do you pull building permits in Encino?
faqs.a: Yes — we handle plans, plan check, and permits through the Encino building and safety department for every remodel, addition, and ADU, and we schedule all required inspections.

faqs.q: Can I build an ADU in Encino?
faqs.a: In most cases, yes. Under California and Encino rules, most single-family lots qualify for a detached, attached, or garage-conversion ADU. We handle feasibility, design, permits, and construction.

faqs.q: How long will my Encino remodel or addition take?
faqs.a: It depends on scope — bathrooms typically run 3–5 weeks, kitchens 4–8 weeks, and room additions 2–4 months. We give you a firm schedule with milestones in your written estimate.
